thread:
Maya (AE): Quick sync — HarborPay wants a short presales POC to prove they can switch from CompetitorX without UX regressions. Scope: top-50 customer prompts, billing parity, and KMS for cardholder data. Can we do a 3-day turnaround? :alarm_clock:
Liam (Solutions): I can run the POC. Clarify: they want exact text parity for those prompts or functional equivalence (meaning same intent + no downstream failures)?
Maya (AE): Legal insisted on no visible regressions for those 50. So text-level parity preferred. They're okay if we note edgecases.
Noah (SRE): Ops note: CompetitorX streams tokens in different chunk sizes which makes the chat UI render differently. We can mimic chunking in our stream layer or show a shim that re-chunks on the client. Both are doable but the shim is faster.
Liam (Solutions): Plan: 1) Build a small compatibility shim that normalizes prompt framing + tokenization. 2) Run side-by-side generator runs and compute diffs. 3) For outputs that diverge, try deterministic seed + n-sampling to surface closest match.
Priya (Security): Security checklist: HarborPay requires in-flight encryption, BYOK, and explicit delete of request logs after POC. We need to answer their questionnaire (about KMS, key ownership, audit logs). Also they will ask for our SOC2 and pen test results.
Maya (AE): They also asked about billing: "If we move, will token billing be 1:1?" Can we prepare an example reconciliation showing token counts across both vendors?
Noah (SRE): Yes — I'll output token counts from our tokenizer for each request and add a small reconciliation CSV. Example minimal curl to capture usage (demo):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-1-medium","input":"SUMMARY: {PROMPT}"}' \
  | jq -r '.usage.total_tokens'
```
Liam (Solutions): For parity testing I'll write a harness that: sends the top-50 prompts to CompetitorX and Redwood, stores responses, token counts, and a similarity score. Will include a small adapter for CompetitorX's post-ranker if needed.
Priya (Security): If we demo BYOK in their cloud, we can do Private mode with our control plane disabled and KMS key in their account. That proves we never see raw keys. We'll need a short runbook for onboarding.
Maya (AE): Timeline: demo for product + security on Thursday, formal report Friday. Can the team hit that?
Noah (SRE): Thursday demo ok if we get prompts by EOD today and grant access to a test KMS or supply a mock. I'll also disable autoscaling to keep billing predictable.
Liam (Solutions): Risk: CompetitorX adds a post-processing reranker that rewrites text; parity might need re-implementing that reranker. I'll flag as a mitigation: offer an adapter or run the reranker in a deterministic eval mode.
Maya (AE): Noted — I'll add that to the risk slide and tell the customer extra work may be needed if reranker is proprietary.
Priya (Security): One legal ask: minimum data retention for POC logs. We'll propose 7 days, auto-delete, and provide a signed attestation. Also confirm we can provide audit logs for every API call.
ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered: sales/poc/harborpay-compat (tests: harness, tokenizer-compare) — status: running
Liam (Solutions): Action items: 1) I'll build harness + prompt-normalizer + adapter (Liam). 2) Noah to prepare dedicated node and token-count exporter (Noah). 3) Priya to draft KMS/crypto answers and POC runbook (Priya). 4) Maya to collect NDA + top-50 prompt CSV (Maya).
Maya (AE): I'll chase the NDA now. Also HarborPay asked about surge protection and burst billing caps — can we show rate-limiting and quota mapping to their existing plan?
Noah (SRE): Yes, we can demo rate-limit policies and quota mapping. I'll include an example config and a short script to enforce a soft cap at their desired QPS.
Liam (Solutions): I'll include a short sample reconciliation script for finance that diffs token counts and flags >10% variance. Small snippet I'll paste in the report.
Priya (Security): FYI — for the Private POC we'll need an escalation path for any potential incident. I'll include contact + on-call escalation in the onboarding doc.
Maya (AE): Great. Standup 10:30 PT tomorrow to sync. Please post progress here so I can update HarborPay. :rocket:
